metadata.case_name: CHAN CHEUK PUI v. MAN CHUN PONG T/A WUIYING (C&H) CONSTRUCTION CO AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: construction worker for village houses (formwork worker)

injuries.description: a laceration on his left scalp
source: As a result of the fall, Mr Chan had a laceration on his left scalp and a deep laceration in his left axilla.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: a deep laceration in his left axilla
source: As a result of the fall, Mr Chan had a laceration on his left scalp and a deep laceration in his left axilla.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: injury to his radial nerve (causing radial nerve palsy)
source: he had injury to his radial nerve (causing radial nerve palsy)
injuries.icd_description: Injury of radial nerve at forearm level

injuries.description: a 20% cut of the long head of triceps
source: a 20% cut of the long head of triceps
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of muscle, fascia or tendon of triceps

injuries.description: a complete cut and thrombosis of the Profunda Brachii artery
source: a complete cut and thrombosis of the Profunda Brachii artery
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified blood vessels at shoulder or upper arm level

source: the current injury was traumatic in nature and there was an additional head injury.

manifestations.description: residual left upper limb weakness and numbness
persistent pain at the axilla wound
muscle wasting in the left arm and forearm
numbness and paraesthesia in the left hand

treatments_received: operation to explore the axilla wound
left wrist splint for half a year

losses.description: Residual left upper limb weakness and numbness and radial nerve palsy with persistent pain at the axilla

comparable_cases.case_name: Frank Yu Yu Kai v Chan Chi Keung
comparable_cases.injury_description: radial nerve palsy (albeit happened during a general anaesthesia operation); plaintiff recovered fully after 1 year
